needs_human.note: After a bulk tag or rename that selects only continuation rows, refresh() is skipped and the rows keep the file data from the answer (old tags or filename).; Copy and cut call onClear without onComplete, so clearedSelectionRef keeps stale ids until the next onClear (carried over from r1, unchanged by this fix).; Restore, which runs only in the trash view, calls onComplete() without the flag. It is irrelevant to the search page.
